verdict.rationale: LobeChat lets you control where data lives in two documented ways: chat data is stored locally on the client by default, and the product can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure for complete data control. Both put residency in the user's hands, but there is no evidence of choosing a region for the hosted cloud service. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for LobeHub's hosted cloud sync, documentation of where cloud-synced data resides, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: LobeHub can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, giving you complete control over your data, customization, and deployment environment.
LobeChat chat data is stored locally on the client-side by default. However, we offer cloud synchronization functionality.
LobeHub Desktop — Powerful features. Runs locally. Privacy-first.
